Production animation sprite sheet for an existing original catgirl website companion, EXACTLY matching the supplied APPROVED character reference. This is an identity-preserve image edit into a sprite atlas, not a redesign. Do not change the face, hairstyle, clothes, headset, body proportions, notebook or drawing style from reference. TRUE alpha transparent background. ONE square sheet of exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS = 16 frames. Equal square cells occupying exact quarters of width/height, no gutters or borders, one full-body character per cell, no labels/text/effects. All cells same scale and same perspective, head size must NEVER change, torso center fixed at 47% cell width, sole baseline 92% cell height, ears top approximately 9% cell height. Do not enlarge shorter poses. Leave 6% empty margin in EACH cell, no clipping, no character overlaps. Mostly front view facing a tiny bit viewer-left, as reference. Each frame must be visibly articulated limbs/eyes/book, not rotating the entire drawing.
ROW ONE: greeting four frames: (1) starting pose matching reference, right hand near shoulder small wave, left holds notebook; (2) right palm up facing viewer, elbow raised, warm smile; (3) right wrist bends toward head with fingers relaxed, warm smile; (4) hand waving outward, eyes smiling closed. Stable grounded feet.
ROW TWO: notebook four frames: (1) both hands begin lifting closed notebook to chest, gaze down; (2) notebook open, eyes reading down; (3) right hand turns a page of open book, eyes focused; (4) eyes look up toward viewer with small smile, book still open. Feet and head size unchanged.
ROW THREE: yawn/stretch four frames: (1) right hand gently covers yawning mouth, half-closed eyes, left notebook held safely at hip; (2) eyes closed, right elbow raising and left elbow relaxed out; (3) right arm stretches above shoulder, gentle happy closed-eye smile, left notebook at hip, spine only slightly extended; (4) arms relaxing back toward chest, eyes opening. No distorted limbs, do not increase head size or overall scale.
ROW FOUR: walking four frames: consistent 3/4 front view angled a little viewer-left, notebook hugged against chest throughout, normal two arms and two legs. (1) viewer-left foot forward, right foot back contact; (2) legs passing with right knee bent lifting foot, torso drops just 1%; (3) right foot forward, left foot back contact; (4) left knee bent lifting foot on passing, torso drops just 1%. Clear alternating foot positions; boots touch same ground baseline as other rows. Tail gently sways just a little. NO new props, no ground/shadow, no text, no white sticker outline, no background paper rectangle. Match the reference EXACTLY at small web-mascot scale. Consistent 2D matte hand-sketch art, not polished glossy anime, not 3D or pixel art.

Create a production 2 COLUMN by 2 ROW SPRITE SHEET, FOUR poses of EXACTLY the same original catgirl 小江 from the provided approved character reference. This is an identity-preserve animation asset edit, NOT a redesign. TRUE transparent alpha background; all space outside characters must be transparent, no solid background, no paper rectangle, no grid lines/text/labels/effects, no ground or external shadow. All feet/lowest parts share baseline at 93% cell height, keep complete tail and ears inside respective cell, at least 6% empty margin. TOP LEFT: DROWSY standing transition: feet together at baseline, eyes half closed, sleepy mouth, right hand gently covers yawn, left arm holds CLOSED green notebook at belly, shoulders softened. Head scale identical to approved character, knees just a little bent.
TOP RIGHT: SITTING AWAKE transition: sits on the floor with both knees folded neatly close to chest, shoes both touching baseline, notebook hugged with both hands at chest, eyes half-open/downward drowsy but NOT closed, head upright.
